_comment: Content transcribed from assets/projects/*.md. Adding a project: (1) add an entry here, (2) create the detail_file, (3) add assets/projects/<slug>/ to pubspec.yaml — folder declarations are NOT recursive. See PROJECT_SPEC.md risk R-7.

tagline.en: Offline-first field research tool for social and financial debt-case assessments.
tagline.ar: تطبيق ميداني يعمل دون اتصال لإجراء البحوث الاجتماعية والمالية لحالات الغارمين.

tagline.en: Automotive parts marketplace shipping a buyer storefront and a seller portal from one codebase.

tagline.en: AI tutor that turns your own study material into 15 kinds of learning artifact.
tagline.ar: مدرّس ذكي يحوّل موادك الدراسية إلى ١٥ نوعًا من المخرجات التعليمية.
